metadata.title: Banyak Referensi, Mana yang Tepat?

timing.note: Each line is its own recording placed on the timeline; cue times come from clip boundaries (and the clips' internal pauses for multi-cue lines), so they are exact to the recordings.

metadata.working_note: Dialogue-led: every line is its own recording (Vidka = Mona, Herry = Bayu, Ardipal = Dito); each scene ends with the table's 5 s hold. Talk/hold choreography is scaled from a 10 s + 5 s plan to the recorded lengths.

captions.text: Pak, artikel saya banyak, tetapi saya bingung memilih.
Buka lagi catatanmu. Apa yang ingin kamu pahami?
Persempit: siswa pemula, ansambel, dan koordinasi tempo.
Artikel terkenal ini membahas musisi profesional.
Hubungkan dengan bukti awal dan bacaan.
Bagaimana siswa pemula menggunakan isyarat bunyi dan gerak
Jelas: siapa, proses apa, dan dalam konteks apa.
Apakah itu menunjukkan tindakan saat latihan?
Ya, untuk menelaah pola penggunaan isyarat.
Perlu ukuran tempo, perbandingan yang sesuai,
dan cara penelitian saya saling terhubung.

limitations.observed: Characters and most props come from generated pose/prop sheets (gemini-3-pro-image) cropped by tools/import-art.mjs; the desk, search box, sticky notes, task card and cursor remain procedural
limitations.impact: Drawing is consistent line art but not the B1 Ryan V4 hand-inked baseline; review the encoded frames rather than assuming equivalence
